summary: Iteration 13 — Verified 8 backend + 11 frontend flows for the NDIS invoice branding batch. Backend 20/20 PASSED (backend_iteration13_test.py): invoice branding snapshot (PUT settings with business_name/abn/invoice_theme=#7C3AED/invoice_style=modern/bank_name/bsb/account_number then POST /api/invoices returns doc with 'business' snapshot matching all 7 fields; GET /api/invoices/{id} preserves it; GET /invoices/{id}/pdf returns valid application/pdf starting with %PDF-, >1500 bytes), 3 styles cycled (modern/classic/minimal — all 3 PDFs valid), POST /api/invoices/apply-business copies current settings onto 2 draft invoices and returns {success:true, updated:2}; snapshot on both invoices flipped from OLD_snap → NEW_snap; empty invoice_ids returns updated:0; PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/sent sets sent_date; regression on /dashboard/stats, /clients, /invoices, /credentials; PATCH /api/auth/me still works with bearer. Frontend (mobile 390x844, logged in as TEST_DEMO_EMAIL) — ALL PASSED: (1) /invoice/new compliance-panel shows 6 checks (name/ndis/contact/issue/due/items) starting 1/6 ok, flips to 6/6 after filling all fields — verified transition. Date inputs accept DD/MM/YYYY typing (values '15/01/2026' and '29/01/2026' persisted). (2) /invoices delete: DELETE del-invoice-<id> triggered browser confirm dialog ('Permanently delete INV-1009 for TEST_iter13 Client?') and after accept the list dropped 9→8; INV-1009 gone. (3) /invoice/{id} shows Preview + Send buttons; header shares testID share-pdf-btn; dates display DD/MM/YYYY (Issued: 15/01/2026, Due: 29/01/2026, Sent: —). Tapping Preview did NOT hit /sent; tapping Send fired PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/sent BEFORE the PDF download (verified in request capture; PDF fetch went through expo-file-system so wasn't captured but ordering in code at [id].tsx:37-39 is correct). (4) /settings — logo-upload button present; 8 accent theme swatches; style-modern/classic/minimal all present; picking theme-#7C3AED + style-modern + Save Profile → apply-to-drafts modal appears with apply-select-all, 8 draft-<id> rows, apply-skip, apply-confirm. Clicking Apply fired POST /api/invoices/apply-business and showed confirm-toast. (5) /vault Bills & Costs seg-bills shows 2 expense cards; tapping expense-<id> opens edit modal pre-filled (bill-name='Budget direct'); tapping save-bill-btn triggers PATCH /api/expenses/{id} and displays confirm-toast 'Cost updated'. New bills display DD/MM/YYYY (Due 05/07/2026); LEGACY bills stored with slash format (2026/07/04) render AS-IS because toDMY splits on '-' only. (6) /planner — day-2026-07-05 has a dot marker and selecting it shows planner-finance MONEY OUT TODAY block with 'TEST_iter13 Bill · Bill due · $50.00'. (7) Feedback — task create fires confirm-toast (NO celebration-overlay); task complete (tapping task card) fires celebration-overlay (NO confirm-toast). Verified both mutually-exclusive. (8) Regression — /dashboard has COMMAND CENTER, /clients shows participants list (Curl Test Client, Mr. Smittty, Sarah Mitchell), /credentials loads Certs & Insurance list, /notes web fallback exposes testID notes-input which accepts typing. Only one minor legacy-data display issue found; core batch is functional end-to-end.

issues: Legacy bills whose renewal_date/due_date is stored in slash format (e.g. '2026/07/04' from before the DD/MM/YYYY migration) display AS-IS instead of DD/MM/YYYY. `src/api.ts:146 toDMY()` splits on '-' only; if the value contains '/' it falls through untouched. Non-blocking (only affects pre-existing data), but visible next to newly-created bills that show correct DD/MM/YYYY.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated on web — use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking carryover from earlier iterations.
props.pointerEvents deprecated on web — use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Celebration.tsx:34 (Burst passes pointerEvents='none' as prop). Non-blocking.
'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — expected web-preview only warning; native builds unaffected.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In `src/api.ts:146 toDMY()`, also handle '/'-separated ISO strings (`s.split(/[-/]/)`) so legacy bills like renewal_date='2026/07/04' render as '04/07/2026' in /vault Bills & Costs. Currently only newly-created bills display DD/MM/YYYY correctly.
OPTIONAL: Migrate Burst's pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents in `/app/frontend/src/components/Celebration.tsx:34` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning (carryover).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:539-573 — POST /api/invoices computes totals, fetches live settings, snapshots business branding via _business_snapshot(), stores it on the invoice document. Verified: GET /api/invoices/{id} returns business snapshot with all 7 branding keys (business_name/abn/invoice_theme/invoice_style/bank_name/bsb/account_number) faithful to the settings at creation time.

server.py:621-634 — POST /api/invoices/apply-business iterates invoice_ids, $set business snapshot from current settings, aggregates modified_count into 'updated'. Returns {success:true, updated:N}. Correctly ignores invalid IDs via try/except. Verified with 2 invoices: OLD_snap → NEW_snap after PUT settings + apply.

server.py:1160-1180 — PDF builder reads the invoice's own business snapshot first, falls back to live settings if a field is missing. Style key = invoice_style|'modern', accent = invoice_theme|'#0A6B7D'. Verified all 3 styles (modern/classic/minimal) return valid application/pdf, %PDF- header, >1500 bytes.

invoice/[id].tsx:34-43 — share() calls api.markInvoiceSent(id) BEFORE shareGetFile PDF, so the PDF carries the sent_date. preview() calls only shareGetFile (never markInvoiceSent). Correct ordering per requirement.

invoices.tsx:88 — del-invoice-<id> button triggers removeInvoice which uses window.confirm (React Native Alert on web) then DELETE /api/invoices/{id}. Verified end-to-end: list count 9→8 after confirm accept.

settings.tsx:196-220 — Apply-to-drafts modal correctly wires apply-select-all (toggle), draft-<id> rows (per-invoice checkbox), apply-skip (close-only) and apply-confirm (POST /api/invoices/apply-business + confirm-toast). Verified all 4 testIDs render and the endpoint is hit.

vault.tsx:84,235,308-313 — openEditBill prefills the modal state, expense-<id> onPress opens Modal with title 'Edit Cost' when editingId is set. Save (save-bill-btn) triggers PATCH /api/expenses/{id} and confirm-toast 'Cost updated'. Verified.

planner.tsx:53-65,123-125 — expenses.forEach adds day-of-due/renewal ISO strings to a Set to render dot markers; selecting a day iterates expenses to build the MONEY OUT TODAY list under planner-finance testID. Verified with a bill on 2026-07-05.

Celebration.tsx:87-95,97-117,130-141 — confirm() is a lightweight 1.5s toast (testID=confirm-toast) with medium haptic + confirm.wav; celebrate() is a 1.4s+300ms overlay (testID=celebration-overlay) with success haptic + optional success.wav (only when opts.sound=true). Verified they are mutually exclusive on task-create (toast only) vs task-complete (celebration only).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11 flows: compliance panel, invoice delete, preview/send ordering, DD/MM/YYYY dates, settings apply-business modal, bill edit prefill+toast, planner finance markers, task-create toast, task-complete celebration, notes web fallback, dashboard/clients/credentials regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://careworker-dash.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/backend_iteration13_test.py -v` from /app. Frontend delete flow uses window.confirm on web — you MUST register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` BEFORE clicking del-invoice-<id> AND use `click(force=True, no_wait_after=True)` (otherwise the synchronous confirm blocks Playwright's click for 30s). Toast/celebration are provider-mounted (visible across screens); check them within 2s of the triggering action because the toast fades in ~1.8s. Login uses placeholder 'you@example.com' + input[type=password] + get_by_text('Sign In', exact=True). PDF share on web uses expo-file-system.downloadAsync which does NOT emit standard page.on('request') events, so verify the ordering of markInvoiceSent vs PDF fetch via code inspection or console logs, not via request capture.
